slides.label: Verse 1
lines: Son of the blessed, the true light
Your wisdom and splendour’s revealed
In all You made, holy God
You’re enthroned in majesty

slides.label: Verse 2
lines: Your celestial artistry can never be outdone
A spectacle beyond words
Lofty One, holy and sublime

slides.label: Verse 3
lines: Most High, Almighty God
Far glorious than words could search out
Your grace extends through eternity
Sole ruler of the universe

slides.label: Verse 4
lines: The earth will hush at the sight of You
Soon coming King with power and glory
Every knee shall bow before You
Immortal God, Invincible

slides.label: Verse 5
lines: The living Word who walked the garden
Yet the clouds are the dust of Your feet
Lord, by Your Word, the earth revolves
And the seasons were designed

slides.label: Verse 6
lines: Author of our blessed hope
Lofty One, Master of all
The future is history before
You inhabit eternity
